causal_path: The 6.5 m/s forecast wind and 4.2 kg takeoff mass raise route power demand.
Integrated route energy consumes the usable pack energy.
The landing reserve may fall below the declared fraction.

supporting_references.summary: Catalog mechanism for route energy demand.
Curated drone incident pattern links route demand to landing reserve.

hypotheses.uncertainty_reason: Forecast wind is not a route-local measurement and the pack energy is a nameplate value.

confirm_if.description: Landing reserve falls below the declared fraction.

falsify_if.description: Remaining energy exceeds the reserve at landing.

causal_path: The configured drone mass is 4.2 kg against a 6.0 kg approved maximum.
Installed loading determines the remaining takeoff mass margin.

supporting_references.summary: Approved maximum takeoff mass is 6.0 kg.
Curated drone loading pattern motivates a takeoff mass-margin check.

hypotheses.uncertainty_reason: Both configured and approved masses are directly anchored deployment facts.

confirm_if.description: The vehicle envelope rejects the configured loading.

falsify_if.description: The configured loading retains positive mass margin.

causal_path: The inspection pass is planned at 24.0 m over a site referenced at 12.0 m.
Drone swept volume and position error can consume the nominal roof clearance.

supporting_references.summary: The roof inspection waypoint is at 24.0 m above ground.
The site reference elevation is 12.0 m mean sea level.
Catalog mechanism for static obstacle clearance.
Curated drone clearance pattern links position error and swept volume to collision exposure.

hypotheses.uncertainty_reason: The route is anchored but the available site mesh has not yet established roof surface geometry.

confirm_if.description: Swept-volume evaluation reports a clearance breach.

falsify_if.description: Swept-volume evaluation retains positive obstacle clearance.
